title: Explore until Confident
summary: Perceive With Confidence 已把 conformal calibration 与学习感知/规划联结；Explore until Confident 已用 multi-step conformal prediction 校准 EQA 停止。故“conformal + confidence stopping”本身不是 TARO novelty；TARO 的候选差异是 partial-metric factor posterior、body/path clearance、非对称 false-clear risk、人类取证成本和 deterministic reducer，但仍须实验证明。

mechanisms.limitations: This adjacent work constrains TARO novelty or supplies a bounded reference. Its source-domain result is not TARO task-functional identifiability, a metric anchor, O0R truth, human-constrained sensing evidence, user benefit, or safety.
